statement: A sixth guild, the fitty IDI Army, now exists; join the Discord; guilds have 600+ members total.
Version 1.86 adds World 5 boss Kattlekruk, new upgrades and the best-in-slot equipment so far.
Blood Berserker's Combustion attack cooldown reduced by 50 percent, now 20 seconds.
Using Combustion no longer uses the Inflamed talent.
Inflamed talent cooldown reduced by 30 seconds to 60 seconds.
Expect much more AOE for Blood Berserker after these changes.
Beastmaster still needs buffs so he stops living in the lab.
King dude companion is now guaranteed within 200 treats via a new pity system.
Hitting the pity threshold grants the companion retroactively.
New limited shop: five-star card Primafire, +10 drop chance premium hat, cosmic candies, hyper ovals, World 5 card pack 50% off, mob respawn keychains.
Free to play players get a Primafire helmet usable as a premium hat.
Kattlekruk entrance on Minor Mole map has Tired Bull NPC with three quests; first is kill six million minor moles.
Second quest is to kill 10 million crawlers.
Final quest gets One of the Divine trophy: 10 weapon power, 30 all stat, 42 drop chance, 35 total damage.
This trophy blows every other combat trophy out of the water.
Trophy requires farming Nightmare Kattlekruk with one quadrillion health and getting two drops.
New pendant drop gives 25 all AFK gains.
It replaces the combat and skilling pendant as best-in-slot pendant.
Another Kattlekruk drop gives 40 skill XP and three percent AFK gains; pray for RNG.
A new oval drop gives five percent all AFK gains.
Believes 100 percent or higher AFK gains is more than possible after these upgrades.
New upgrade stones have 60 percent success chance and consume an upgrade slot on failure.
Keep using World 5 stones for armor and weapons because crafting is expensive.
Use new upgrade stones on tools to reach higher prints.
Farm Kattlekruk keys at Minor Moles, crawlers and Trevor worms.
Nine potential new merit task upgrades unlock all the new weapons and armor.
Boots and helmet give more drop rate and total damage percent.
Chests and legs give total damage percent and mob respawn.
Chest and legs are half decent; unsure they will replace magma.
The new weapons are a huge increase over magma weapons.
Get the new weapons ASAP; little to no effort if you already have magma weapons.
Active mains Elemental Sorcerer Divine Knight Void Walker: full magma except helmet and boots for extra drop rate.
AFK characters Beastmaster Blood Berserker Siegebreaker should run the new chest and legs.
Keep Bubo in magma armor because he needs the all stat which feeds money percent.
Roadmap includes Island Expeditions; he hopes they are party oriented.
Roadmap has more World 4 and 5 completion trophies and secrets.
World 6 leaked as Spirited Valley and is not a water world.
Three elite classes will come in World 7 and three in World 8.
He thinks having no new classes in World 6 is better so skills can be based around everybody.
